tiebreaker_total_a1_closest_share_2020_2.description: Tiebreaker total arm A1 (market total as quoted) vs A0, expected share of the tiebreak against 284 rivals drawn from a DECLARED field (normal around the market total, sigma 13.299 from 2009-2019 actual-minus-market, rounded to integers; no capture holds real rival guesses). UNITS PLACEHOLDER: the effect is a closest-share PROBABILITY difference, not a correlation. EFFECT_UNITS has no probability unit and labelling a 0.35%-scale tiebreak-win share accuracy_points would put a non-commensurable quantity into the NFL ATS pool. Never pool this row with anything but its own family. Predeclared in docs/tiebreaker_total.md; 107 last-games-of-week 2020-2025; paired week-blocked bootstrap 20000 draws seed 20260821; baseline is A0, the tiebreaker chain served today (joint-residual total blended at 0.1, then the pick-side-consistent score lattice).
tiebreaker_total_a1_closest_share_2020_2.notes: Realized-hit estimator: over 107 weeks this arm hit the exact total twice, so the mean is a 2-count statistic and the interval is wide by construction.
tiebreaker_total_a1_closest_share_2020_2.plain_summary: How often each guess would win the weekly tiebreaker against 284 other entries. Submitting the raw betting total was no better than what we publish.
